title: Insulin signaling regulates longevity through protein phosphorylation in Caenorhabditis elegans.
authors: Li, Wen-Jun; Wang, Chen-Wei; Tao, Li; Yan, Yong-Hong; Zhang, Mei-Jun; Liu, Ze-Xian; Li, Yu-Xin; Zhao, Han-Qing; Li, Xue-Mei; He, Xian-Dong; Xue, Yu; Dong, Meng-Qiu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究胰岛素信号通过蛋白磷酸化调控线虫寿命，虽涉及FOXO转录因子但核心是磷酸化组学与寿命机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Insulin/IGF-1 Signaling (IIS) is known to constrain longevity by inhibiting the transcription factor FOXO. How phosphorylation mediated by IIS kinases regulates lifespan beyond FOXO remains unclear. Here, we profile IIS-dependent phosphorylation changes in a large-scale quantitative phosphoproteomic analysis of wild-type and three IIS mutant Caenorhabditis elegans strains. We quantify more than 15,000 phosphosites and find that 476 of these are differentially phosphorylated in the long-lived daf-2/insulin receptor mutant. We develop a machine learning-based method to prioritize 25 potential lifespan-related phosphosites. We perform validations to show that AKT-1 pT492 inhibits DAF-16/FOXO and compensates the loss of daf-2 function, that EIF-2alpha pS49 potently inhibits protein synthesis and daf-2 longevity, and that reduced phosphorylation of multiple germline proteins apparently transmits reduced DAF-2 signaling to the soma. In addition, an analysis of kinases with enriched substrates detects that casein kinase 2 (CK2) subunits negatively regulate lifespan. Our study reveals detailed functional insights into longevity.
abstract_zh: 已知胰岛素/IGF-1信号通路（IIS）通过抑制转录因子FOXO来限制寿命。然而，IIS激酶介导的磷酸化如何调控寿命，除FOXO外尚不清楚。在此，我们通过对野生型和三种IIS突变体秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）菌株进行大规模定量磷酸化蛋白质组学分析，描绘了IIS依赖性磷酸化变化。我们量化了超过15,000个磷酸化位点，并发现其中476个在长寿的daf-2/胰岛素受体突变体中差异磷酸化。我们开发了一种基于机器学习的方法，优先筛选出25个潜在的寿命相关磷酸化位点。我们进行验证，表明AKT-1 pT492抑制DAF-16/FOXO并补偿daf-2功能缺失，EIF-2alpha pS49强烈抑制蛋白质合成及daf-2长寿效应，而多个生殖系蛋白的磷酸化减少显然将减弱的DAF-2信号传递至体细胞。此外，对富集底物的激酶分析检测到酪蛋白激酶2（CK2）亚基负调控寿命。我们的研究为长寿机制提供了详细的功能性见解。
